query: UPDATE molecules SET chemicalFormula = 'C₁₅H₂₆O' WHERE (name LIKE '%Bisabolol%' OR name LIKE '%Farnesol%' OR name LIKE '%Nérolidol%' OR name LIKE '%Nerolidol%' OR name LIKE '%Guaiol%' OR name LIKE '%Cédrol%' OR name LIKE '%Cedrol%' OR name LIKE '%Patchoulol%' OR name LIKE '%Eudesmol%' OR name LIKE '%Vétiver%' OR name LIKE '%Vetiver%') AND (chemicalFormula IS NULL OR chemicalFormula = '');
